 Job Scan Home / GST / GST Reforms to Roll Out in Phases from Nov 1: Know What Changes GST Law Report GST Reforms to Roll Out in Phases from Nov 1: Know What Changes
 GST process reforms that do not require amendments to the law are expected to begin from November 1, 2026 and major statutory changes are targeted for April 1, 2027.
 By  Kavi Priya · 24 Oct 2026, 5:51 pm IST 2′ read Save Get the day's tax rulings in your inbox 
 Email address Subscribe × The Goods and Services Tax (GST) reforms recommended by the 57th GST Council are set to be introduced in phases from November 1, 2026 with the first set focusing mainly on easier registration, faster refunds and simpler compliance. Reforms requiring amendments to the Central and State GST laws are expected to follow from April 1, 2027.
 CBIC Member (GST) Sanjay Mangal said that wherever amendments to the GST Acts are not required, the changes would be implemented as soon as possible, tentatively beginning November 1. Implementation will depend on the system and administrative changes required for each measure.
